propositions: Python 3.11 asyncio.wait_for consumes external cancellation when child completes in same turn, causing worker to loop with pending cancellation count while lifespan awaits forever
TestClient teardown hangs after test_matching_guard_is_accepted on Python 3.11 when cancellation and job completion collide in opcert worker
Replacing asyncio.wait_for with asyncio.timeout semantics preserves external cancellation and prevents worker from returning to queue with cancelling()>0
Deterministic harness reproduces cancellation/completion race distinctly on Python 3.11 (done=False/cancelling=1) versus Python 3.12 (done=True/cancelled=True)
Fix in app.py:76-83 using async with asyncio.timeout maintains per-job timeout, ACK behavior, and terminal record schema while restoring prompt shutdown
